run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the lower insertion point of a value in a sorted array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple sorted array inputs to verify correct insertion point results
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold exponential search algorithm that finds the lower insertion point of X in arr
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses exponential probing then linear scan to find insertion index
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use binary search instead of exponential search for finding the lower insertion point
